description: The Global Yield Gap Atlas team processed daily weather inputs for crop simulations at 12 Kenyan locations over 1998–2012. The revised DANS release combines TRMM rainfall and NASA POWER temperature and dew-point estimates, bias-corrected using shorter local station records where available. It provides daily CSV weather tables and supporting text or ZIP files through a named public repository page. The DANS record lists CC0 1.0 and no price. A food-supply modeller can drive crop-growth and yield-gap simulations where continuous measured weather is sparse. The corrected remote-sensing and reanalysis values remain estimates; they do not replace long, local observations. Site selection focuses on crop-growing areas and does not cover every Kenyan climate zone. File contents and the correction implementation were not checked by download. This release is related to the older DOI 10.17026/DANS-XC8-3A2Q, whose own description says that its files are no longer accessible. A previous agriculture candidate rejected this DOI as out of scope; the article and provider metadata explicitly establish its crop-model input use.
